subject: Hi.
author: Paul_Dnap
body:
I know what you mean with the traffic checking; but when you get the Burnout Team van or the 4x4 you can do some more traffic checking (apart from buses or other vans) so you can always use those. But showtime is great for the smashing stuff up (especially buses!!).

And yeah, Burnout is a great tool for learning how to swear properly.

subject: Re: Intro from Denmark
author: Xandu
body:
Hi and welcome to the site. It is always nice when people take the time to introduce themselves. I think you are our first Danish member.

If you haven't play online on XBox Live you should defenitely give it a try. You get a one month gold membership for free when you create a new gamertag. So that is a great way to try it for free. All the Burnout Games (3, Revenge and Paradise) are lots of fun online. ... so it can quickly take a lot of time 🙂

-- The Creator --

subject: hello and welcome..
author: PsychedelicBabe
body:
😃Hello and welcome to the zany world of Burnout. its nice to see another female with the same pleasures in life as myself....i hope you enjoy your gaming experience with the Burnout series and playing online is so much more fun i highly recommend you at least try it....what have you got to lose....if you decide you dont like it then there are plenty of offline games you can enjoy....but i cant see any reason why you wouldnt enjoy it....so go on be a devil and feel the adrenalin that us other racers experience.....and then youll see why after all this time people still share the same passion for the adrenalin and the community.....hopefully ill be seeing your name in the lobby till then enjoy.....😉

 

 

I'm looking for the spaceman who stole my smile....he cant be far away....hopefully....
